question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: **INTRANSIGENT**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Stubborn (Option 3)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Intransigent"** means unwilling or refusing to change one's views or to agree about something. (अडिग/हठी)
 
 
• **Example:** The intransigent manager refused to negotiate with the striking employees.
 
 
• **"Stubborn"** refers to a person's determination not to change their mind or attitude, no matter the situation or external pressure. (ज़िद्दी)
 
 
• **Example:** The stubborn child refused to eat anything other than pizza for dinner.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Intransigent' **is **'Stubborn'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Stubborn (Option 3)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Willing** (इच्छुक): Ready, eager, or prepared to do something.
 
 
• **Example:** She was willing to help her friend with the project despite her busy schedule.
 
 
 
• **Compliant** (अनुकूल): Inclined to agree with others or obey rules, especially to an excessive degree.
 
 
• **Example:** The compliant employee followed every company policy without question.
 
 
 
• **Submissive** (आज्ञाकारी): Ready to conform to the authority or will of others; meekly obedient or passive.
 
 
• **Example:** The dog was submissive to its owner's commands during training sessions.
